request: Goal: Implement GitHub Issue #413, the flow closure from impl repair through semantic acceptance, resolving F-002 and F-003 in independently implementable, reviewable, revertible, and verifiable units. Scope: add impl-triage and impl-repair states; always route repaired work back through test-execute; invalidate artifacts from test-execute through acceptance-review when the relevant fingerprint changes; record invalidation reason and previous fingerprint in the ledger; evaluate original request, explicit requirements, produced diff, repair audit evidence, and test evidence per requirement unit; route notMet to repair and notVerifiable only to an approval-required decision; prevent automatic risk acceptance or abort. Target paths: src/flow/definition.js, src/flow/lib/run-review.js, src/flow/lib/run-acceptance-review.js, src/flow/lib/acceptance-review-artifacts.js, acceptance schema, and impl prompts. Verification: first reproduce failure on pre-fix source, prove every acceptance criterion with automated tests or reproducible commands, retain existing success behavior, never force success by directly mutating state or artifacts, and prove stale artifacts cannot satisfy a CLI-only FAIL to repair to retest to PASS scenario. Update necessary docs when source behavior changes. Dependencies and scheduling: depends on D-01, integrate into test:ci after D-03, use the Wave 2 flow semantic lane and do not overlap D-10, D-11, or D-13. Out of scope: unrelated findings, npm publish, npm dist-tag, and formal release execution.
